definitions.explanation: Someone who is involved in or connected to a particular matter, organization, or event. Often used to indicate authorized personnel or people with a connection to a situation.

examples.japanese: {関係者|かんけいしゃ}{以外|いがい}{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}。
examples.english: No entry except for authorized persons.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{関係者|かんけいしゃ}から{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: I spoke with people involved in the incident.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{関係者|かんけいしゃ}によると、{来年度|らいねんど}からカリキュラムが{大|おお}きく{変|か}わるそうだ。
examples.english: According to school officials, the curriculum will change significantly starting next year.

notes:
{関係者|かんけいしゃ} is a compound of {関係|かんけい} (relation) + {者|しゃ} (person). It covers a broad range of meanings from "authorized personnel" (on signs) to "parties involved" (in news reports) to "stakeholders" (in business).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}{以外|いがい}{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}: no entry except authorized personnel
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}{各位|かくい}: to all concerned parties (formal notices)
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}によると: according to those involved
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}に{聞|き}く: to ask the people involved

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS WITH {者|しゃ}:
- {担当者|たんとうしゃ}: person in charge
- {責任者|せきにんしゃ}: person responsible
- {当事者|とうじしゃ}: the party directly concerned

NOTE:
The sign {関係者|かんけいしゃ}{以外|いがい}{立入禁止|たちいりきんし} is one of the most commonly seen restriction signs in Japan.
